text: This report is in response to City Council request for the General Manager, Transportation Services, to provide information on maintenance service levels for public walkways. In addition, the report discusses the need to develop a multi-divisional city-wide strategy to maintain public walkways in a state of good repair, including information on how these walkways are inventoried, inspected, and maintained.
The Infrastructure and Environment Committee received the report (December 20, 2021) from the General Manager, Transportation Services for information.
